memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah. So Abimelek summoned Isaac and said, 'She is really your wife! Why did you say, "She is my sister"?' Isaac answered him, 'Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her.' Then Abimelek said, 'What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.' So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: 'Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.'" - Gen 26:8-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Isaac's lie is exposed when Abimelek sees him being affectionate with Rebekah. What follows is almost embarrassing: a pagan king has to rebuke the man of faith. "What is this you have done to us?" Abimelek is rightly upset that Isaac's deception could have brought guilt on the whole community.

There is a humbling truth here. Sometimes people outside the faith show more integrity than God's own people. Isaac's fear had led him into a lie that endangered others, while Abimelek acted honourably. It is a reminder that our failures are noticed, and they can damage our witness before a watching world.

Yet look at God's grace. Despite Isaac's foolish choice, God protects Rebekah, and Abimelek ends up issuing an order to keep them both safe. Isaac did not deserve such protection, but God watched over him anyway. Even when we make a mess through fear and sin, God's faithfulness does not fail.

This is not permission to sin, but comfort for the fallen. If you have made a foolish choice out of fear, do not despair. Confess it, learn from it, and receive the grace of a God who covers even our failures and works for our good (Rom 8:28). His mercy is greater than our mistakes.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does my conduct strengthen or weaken my witness to others?
2. Where have I seen God protect me despite my own failures?
3. How does God's grace over my mistakes move me to walk more honestly?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your grace covers even my foolish choices. Help me to live with integrity so that my life honours You before others. Amen.
